description.value:
Even 50 years later, the CLose Assault Weapon (CLAW) is terrifying to oppose, but it’s also woefully outdated. So, United Armaments created the Modern Assault Weapon (MAW). It fires low-velocity 8-gauge explosive slugs, which are stored in an autoloading belt feed along the weapon’s spine. The CLAW’s underbarrel armament system was even kept — but who needs that much firepower? Apparently, MAX-TAC does.

Cost: 10,000eb (Super Luxury)

Class: EQ Grenade Launcher • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: SMG

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 14 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Explosive

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Belt Box, Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Explosives fired from this weapon only explode in a 6x6m/yds (3x3 squares) area. As an Action, the user can install/uninstall a One-Handed Ranged Weapon (that need not be concealable) into the frame of this weapon. Swapping between the Grenade Launcher and installed weapon does not take an Action and can be done anytime the user fires this weapon. Attachments or Mods on one weapon do not affect the other, and each must be reloaded separately. Requires BODY 11+ or being Mounted to wield.

Range: SMG
Pre-installed: Belt Box, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Explosive

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
